# hanji (@hanji/react)

> hanji for the web: accessible compound components on Base UI, styled by tokens, with zero-runtime CSS and an agent-readable manifest.

Compound React components on Base UI. Plain CSS in cascade layers, themed by --hj-* tokens (three papers × twelve accents, density, motion policy). Install `@hanji/react @hanji/tokens @base-ui/react`, import `@hanji/react/styles.css` once, wrap the app in `<Theme>`. Every part takes className (string or fn of state), style, and render. Prefer the documented parts; do not restyle internals — use variants, tokens, slot classes or `--hj-<component>-*` variables.

## Setup

- [Theme schema](./theme.schema.json): JSON Schema for createTheme() — paper, accent, density, motion, radius, fonts, colors, springs.
- [Manifest](./manifest.json): every component as structured JSON.

## Icons (@hanji/icons)

- 1,500+ icons, each in `outline` (1.5 line), `solid` and `wash` (line over a 16% fill). Reshaped from Solar by 480 Design (CC BY 4.0): softened joins, rounder corners, hanji names and aliases (chevron-down, trash, more, x, plus…).
- Motion: `active={liked}` floods a toggle with ink on a spring (like, bookmark, star); `animate="draw" | "pop" | "ring" | "shake" | "spin"` plays on mount and replays when `trigger` changes. Uses hanji's spring tokens; reduced motion becomes fades.
- `import { IconTrashBinTrash } from '@hanji/icons'` (or its alias `IconTrash`) → `<IconTrash variant="solid" size={20} label="Delete" />`. Size defaults to 1em; colour is currentColor; `--hj-icon-stroke` retunes every line.
- Names chosen at runtime: `import { DynamicIcon } from '@hanji/icons/dynamic'` loads only that icon (names and aliases). Use hanji icons inside components with `<HanjiProvider icons={iconAdapter('outline')}>` from `@hanji/icons/adapter`.
- Find one: the MCP tools `search_icons` and `get_icon`, or `@hanji/icons/icons.json` (names, aliases, tags, categories, SVG for every style).

## Atoms

- [Artwork](./packages/react/dist/docs/artwork.md): Generated cover art for anything without an image: 100 faces (ten palettes × ten compositions) chosen by hashing an id, printed on hanji’s paper fibres. Plus collage covers, glyph covers and a real image with art standing in.
- [Avatar](./packages/react/dist/docs/avatar.md): A person as a picture, or as their initials on a tint that stays theirs everywhere.
- [Badge](./packages/react/dist/docs/badge.md): A count or a dot on top of something: unread messages, new releases, items waiting.
- [Button](./packages/react/dist/docs/button.md): The verb on a screen: triggers an action.
- [Chip](./packages/react/dist/docs/chip.md): Small, tappable facts: a filter to turn on, a value that was picked, a suggested action.
- [Kbd](./packages/react/dist/docs/kbd.md): A keyboard key, set in mono on a hairline, for shortcuts in menus, fields and help text.
- [Link](./packages/react/dist/docs/link.md): A styled anchor that goes somewhere, in running text or in chrome.
- [Scrim](./packages/react/dist/docs/scrim.md): A gradient that darkens imagery just enough for text to sit on it, in one colour fading by opacity.
- [Separator](./packages/react/dist/docs/separator.md): A hairline between groups — hanji’s way of separating instead of boxing.
- [Skeleton](./packages/react/dist/docs/skeleton.md): A still block in the shape of what is coming, so the page keeps its layout while it loads.
- [Spinner](./packages/react/dist/docs/spinner.md): An ink ring for work that takes a moment and has no measurable progress.
- [Squircle](./packages/react/dist/docs/squircle.md): A continuous-corner (squircle) surface — hanji’s corner, exact on every browser.
- [Status](./packages/react/dist/docs/status.md): A state in words — word, glyph and tint — with when it happened.
- [Text](./packages/react/dist/docs/text.md): Text set in one of hanji’s type roles, from the hero number down to the mono timecode.

## Controls

- [Autocomplete](./packages/react/dist/docs/autocomplete.md): A text input that suggests as you type. The value is the text; suggestions only help.
- [Calendar](./packages/react/dist/docs/calendar.md): A month grid for picking a day or a range. No dependencies: local days, names from Intl.
- [Checkbox](./packages/react/dist/docs/checkbox.md): A box you tick for a yes/no choice that takes effect when the form is saved.
- [CheckboxGroup](./packages/react/dist/docs/checkbox-group.md): Several related checkboxes sharing one value array, with an optional “Select all” parent.
- [ChoiceCard](./packages/react/dist/docs/choice-card.md): A radio group drawn as cards, each stating what choosing it will cost.
- [Combobox](./packages/react/dist/docs/combobox.md): Type to filter a list and pick one value, or several shown as chips in the field.
- [DatePicker](./packages/react/dist/docs/date-picker.md): A field-like trigger that opens a Calendar in a popover, for a day or a range.
- [DropZone](./packages/react/dist/docs/drop-zone.md): Takes files for a form — by drag and drop, the native picker or paste — checks type, size and count, and lists them with upload progress, errors and retry.
- [Field](./packages/react/dist/docs/field.md): A labelled text input with its help line and its error, wired for validation and screen readers.
- [Fieldset](./packages/react/dist/docs/fieldset.md): Groups related fields under a legend; consecutive groups are divided by a hairline, never boxed.
- [Form](./packages/react/dist/docs/form.md): A form that validates its Fields together, takes server errors by field name, and sums them up after a failed submit.
- [NumberField](./packages/react/dist/docs/number-field.md): A number stepped with − and +, held to repeat, or typed — with changed digits rolling into place.
- [OTPField](./packages/react/dist/docs/otp-field.md): A one-time code entered one character per cell, pasted or typed.
- [PasswordField](./packages/react/dist/docs/password-field.md): A Field for passwords: a reveal toggle and an optional strength line that says what to do.
- [RadioGroup](./packages/react/dist/docs/radio-group.md): Exactly one of a few options, all visible at once.
- [Rating](./packages/react/dist/docs/rating.md): Choose one to five stars, or read an average as stars and a number.
- [SegmentedControl](./packages/react/dist/docs/segmented-control.md): Two to five short, mutually exclusive options in one pill, with an indicator that slides to the choice.
- [Select](./packages/react/dist/docs/select.md): Choose one value (or several) from a list that is too long, or too dynamic, for radios.
- [Slider](./packages/react/dist/docs/slider.md): A value on a continuous scale where the feel matters more than the exact number.
- [Switch](./packages/react/dist/docs/switch.md): An on/off setting that applies the moment it is flipped.
- [Toggle](./packages/react/dist/docs/toggle.md): A button that stays pressed until pressed again: Shuffle, Bold, Mute.
- [ToggleGroup](./packages/react/dist/docs/toggle-group.md): A row of Toggles in one frame, sharing a value array.

## Surfaces

- [AlertDialog](./packages/react/dist/docs/alert-dialog.md): A confirm that must be answered: says what will happen to what, and offers at most two choices.
- [Banner](./packages/react/dist/docs/banner.md): An inline notice that stays on the page until it is resolved or dismissed.
- [Card](./packages/react/dist/docs/card.md): A surface for one thing — an album, an episode, an article — usually a link to it.
- [CoachMark](./packages/react/dist/docs/coach-mark.md): A short product tour: a spotlight on a real control and a bubble that says what it does, one step at a time.
- [ContextMenu](./packages/react/dist/docs/context-menu.md): A Menu opened by right-click or long-press on an area, at the pointer.
- [Dialog](./packages/react/dist/docs/dialog.md): A centred question or short task that stops the page until it is answered.
- [Menu](./packages/react/dist/docs/menu.md): A list of commands that opens from a button: actions, options and nested choices.
- [Menubar](./packages/react/dist/docs/menubar.md): A row of menus (File · Edit · View) that behave as one, for desktop-style apps.
- [Popover](./packages/react/dist/docs/popover.md): A small anchored surface for detail or a quick task that belongs to the thing that opened it.
- [PreviewCard](./packages/react/dist/docs/preview-card.md): A card that previews where a link goes when the pointer rests on it or it gets focus.
- [ScrollArea](./packages/react/dist/docs/scroll-area.md): A native scroll container with a thin overlay scrollbar and edges that fade where content continues.
- [Sheet](./packages/react/dist/docs/sheet.md): A surface that rises from an edge with options or detail, keeping the screen behind it in view. Swipe it away.
- [Toast](./packages/react/dist/docs/toast.md): A brief, announced message about something that just happened, with at most one action.
- [Tooltip](./packages/react/dist/docs/tooltip.md): A short label that names a control on hover or keyboard focus.

## Navigation

- [Accordion](./packages/react/dist/docs/accordion.md): A stack of headings that each reveal their own section.
- [Breadcrumbs](./packages/react/dist/docs/breadcrumbs.md): Where this page sits in a hierarchy, with a way back up each level.
- [Collapsible](./packages/react/dist/docs/collapsible.md): One region the user can show or hide: “Show 6 more”, “Advanced options”.
- [Command](./packages/react/dist/docs/command.md): A command palette: a search field over grouped commands, ranked as you type, inline or as a ⌘K dialog.
- [NavigationMenu](./packages/react/dist/docs/navigation-menu.md): A site’s top navigation: links and triggers that open rich link panels in one shared, morphing surface.
- [Pagination](./packages/react/dist/docs/pagination.md): Moves through numbered pages of a long list or table.
- [Steps](./packages/react/dist/docs/steps.md): Shows progress through a short ordered task: where you are, what’s done, what’s left.
- [TabBar](./packages/react/dist/docs/tab-bar.md): The mobile-web bottom bar: three to five top-level destinations, icon over label.
- [Tabs](./packages/react/dist/docs/tabs.md): Switches between views of the same subject without leaving the page.
- [Toolbar](./packages/react/dist/docs/toolbar.md): A group of controls that acts as one tab stop; arrow keys move inside it.
- [Tree](./packages/react/dist/docs/tree.md): A tree view: nested items that open and close, with roving focus, the full APG keyboard, single or multiple selection and children that can load on first open.

## Data

- [Counter](./packages/react/dist/docs/counter.md): A number whose changed digits roll into place, so a change is seen without re-reading the whole figure.
- [DataTable](./packages/react/dist/docs/data-table.md): A data grid for thousands of rows: columns as data, sorting, a checkbox column with select-all and Shift-click ranges, a sticky header, and only the rows on screen in the DOM (virtua). The keyboard works like a spreadsheet.
- [DragList](./packages/react/dist/docs/drag-list.md): A list you reorder by picking a row up: the handle lifts at once, a long press lifts from anywhere else, and every drag has a keyboard twin.
- [EmptyState](./packages/react/dist/docs/empty-state.md): What fills a region when there is nothing to show: a glyph, a title, one sentence and the way out.
- [List](./packages/react/dist/docs/list.md): Rows of 56px: artwork or an icon, a title and a line under it, and a value or chevron on the right.
- [Marquee](./packages/react/dist/docs/marquee.md): A single line too long for its box — a track title on a player — that rests, then travels so the whole of it can be read.
- [Meter](./packages/react/dist/docs/meter.md): A measurement within a known range, coloured by how good it is: storage, battery, signal, password strength.
- [Progress](./packages/react/dist/docs/progress.md): How far a task has got: a 4px track with a fill, and an optional label and value.
- [ProgressRing](./packages/react/dist/docs/progress-ring.md): Progress as a ring: a 40px status beside a row, or a 96px summary with the value inside.
- [Stat](./packages/react/dist/docs/stat.md): A number that matters: what it counts, the figure with its unit shrunk, how it compares in words, and the recent past as a line.
- [SwipeActions](./packages/react/dist/docs/swipe-actions.md): A row that slides aside to reveal actions underneath (iOS Mail style), on an interruptible spring — with a full swipe that commits, and a More menu that is the same actions for everyone who doesn’t swipe.
- [Table](./packages/react/dist/docs/table.md): Rows of records compared across columns: hairlines, a sticky header, sortable columns, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures.
- [Timeline](./packages/react/dist/docs/timeline.md): A vertical sequence of steps with their times: what happened, what is happening, what is next, and what failed.
- [VirtualList](./packages/react/dist/docs/virtual-list.md): A long list that renders only the rows on screen, built on virtua: rows measure themselves, the reading position holds still as rows above change size or older rows are prepended, scrollToIndex jumps anywhere, and orientation="horizontal" makes it a shelf.

## Ai

- [Attachment](./packages/react/dist/docs/attachment.md): A file attached to a prompt or message: type glyph, name, size or error, remove, and an upload bar.
- [Citation](./packages/react/dist/docs/citation.md): An inline numbered source in a reply, with a preview card of the source on hover or focus.
- [CodeBlock](./packages/react/dist/docs/code-block.md): Code inside a reply or doc: syntax-highlighted from the theme (TS/JS/JSX, CSS, JSON, shell, HTML built in; Shiki or Prism pluggable), language and filename, copy (button, floating button or ⌘C), soft-wrap, line numbers. Snippet is the one-line, copy-first form for install commands and imports.
- [Conversation](./packages/react/dist/docs/conversation.md): A scrolling log of turns that keeps the newest reply in view while it streams — until the person scrolls up to read.
- [Message](./packages/react/dist/docs/message.md): One turn in a conversation: the person’s bubble, the assistant’s reply, or a system note.
- [MessageActions](./packages/react/dist/docs/message-actions.md): The small icon actions under an assistant reply: copy, regenerate, rate, more.
- [ModelPicker](./packages/react/dist/docs/model-picker.md): Chooses which model answers: the current one in a quiet trigger, each option with its provider, a capability line and tags.
- [PromptInput](./packages/react/dist/docs/prompt-input.md): The box a person types a prompt into: grows with the text, sends on Enter, becomes Stop while a reply streams.
- [Reasoning](./packages/react/dist/docs/reasoning.md): A model’s visible thinking: open while it works, folded to “Thought for 12 s” when the answer starts.
- [StreamingText](./packages/react/dist/docs/streaming-text.md): Renders a model’s streamed text with zero React work per token.
- [Suggestions](./packages/react/dist/docs/suggestions.md): A row of ready-made prompts the person can send with one tap.
- [ToolCall](./packages/react/dist/docs/tool-call.md): One tool an assistant called — name, status, arguments and result — collapsed to a line until opened.
